item.title: The Lady From Shanghai
item.description:
The dark triad overexposed. Incidentally it also features the vice of stupidity. It would be incomplete without some Columbia leeches taking their pieces out of the movie.

PS: Even though I don’t have a complete idea about the intent behind the quote on the topic of nature, other artful choices remind me of some Kurosawa pieces in terms of inspirational quality.
